**A proxy won't stop Java4Shell. Neither will -XX:UseAVX=2.**

Sixty-four A's and one = can corrupt an OpenJDK server's heap.

**Calif turned it into remote code execution in Jenkins, Jira and Keycloak.**

Three plans, per Calif's own write-up.

**Which did you try first? Save this.**
bullets: Buffering proxy: Calif's Elasticsearch chain needs only one request.
-XX:UseAVX=2: a JVM on ARM won't even start.
Works: patch, with -XX:-UseBASE64Intrinsics until you can.
